name: OpenTherm adapter (boiler bus to 3.3 V logic)

pins.name: IN
pins.notes: What the boiler sends, as a 3.3 V logic signal. To a GPIO with an interrupt

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: What the board sends to the boiler. From an output GPIO

pins.name: OT1
pins.notes: OpenTherm bus to the boiler (2 wires, no polarity). Never to a board pin

pins.name: OT2
pins.notes: OpenTherm bus to the boiler (2 wires, no polarity). Never to a board pin

gotchas.text: The OpenTherm bus works at boiler voltages (well above 3.3 V): connect it only to the adapter's bus terminals, never to a board pin.

source.title: OpenTherm Protocol Specification v2.2
source.section: Physical layer: voltage levels from the master, current levels from the slave

sources.title: OpenTherm Protocol Specification v2.2
sources.section: Physical layer: two-wire, polarity-free point-to-point link; Manchester-coded frames of 32 bits
